entities.summary: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore is a reputed business school located in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. Established in 1973, it was chronologically the third in the first generation of IIMs, after IIM Calcutta and IIM Ahmedabad, thereby forming the elite Indian B-School trio colloquially known as "ABC", or "IIM A/B/C".
